commands.title: GasCity Cockpit: Reconnect to Supervisor API

gascityCockpit.api.url.markdownDescription: Explicit base URL of the gascity supervisor API (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8372`). Highest-priority discovery source — overrides the discovery descriptor and the default. Leave empty to auto-discover.

gascityCockpit.api.token.markdownDescription: Optional bearer token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to the supervisor API. Leave empty for the default localhost (unauthenticated) setup.

gascityCockpit.api.healthPollSeconds.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to poll `/health` while connected, to detect the API going away (e.g. `gc stop` or a supervisor restart).

gascityCockpit.api.reconnect.baseDelayMs.markdownDescription: Base delay (ms) for exponential reconnect backoff after the API becomes unreachable.
